aiReviewsSummary.content: Customers find the water fountain easy to set up and clean, taking it apart and maintaining it every 2-3 weeks, while appreciating its quiet operation and pet-friendly design. However, the fountain's reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some report it lasts for years, others mention the pump stops working after two months. Moreover, opinions on value for money are divided, with some finding it well worth the investment while others regret their purchase.

reviews.title: Sharp stainless appearance, but high-maintenance pump reality. Ended up as a bowl.
reviews.body: From an appearance standpoint, this fountain is undeniably sharp. The brushed 304 food-grade stainless steel looks sleek and clean on tile or hardwood, avoiding the tacky plastic aesthetic of cheaper models while resisting scratches and feline chin acne. Out of the carton, it delivers the look of a durable, commercial-grade hydration station.Where the unit breaks down is daily ease of use and long-term pump reliability. In theory, circulating water through charcoal filters sounds effortless; in domestic practice, the multi-piece top tray and tight pump intake act as an immediate trap for saliva, floating hair, and biological slime. The submersible pump runs quietly at first, but its small impeller quickly loses flow and gums up with gunk unless you perform a tedious, thirty-minute teardown with pipe cleaners every seventy-two hours.Without obsessive follow-up cleaning, the water turns visibly filthy faster than a standard still dish. We stripped the top fountain attachment off first, and within a few weeks, unplugged the pump entirely and stashed the electrical gear in a drawer. The wide 108-ounce stainless basin is fantastic on its own—stable, dishwasher-safe, and heavy enough not to tip—but paying thirty dollars for pump electronics and replacement filters just to end up with a manual water bowl is poor value for money. Buy it if you want the very nice metal look, but expect a serious cleaning chore if you plan to keep the pump running.

reviews.title: This one's all wet.
reviews.body: My two cats and I liked it at first, but now it gets slimy no matter what I do. I use filtered water and clean it two or three times a week. It's nice that most of the parts (the tank, bowl, spout, and such) are easy to clean by hand or put in the dishwasher... But the pump is just too difficult to keep clean. Taking it apart is a complicated hassle; It's tough to open and the inside elements are tiny and difficult to handle. I think gunk hides in parts of the pump I just can reach properly and can't kill with a soap or even a little occasional vinegar (and yes, rinse thoroughly). Now, instead of drinking from the fountain, my bigger cat rest near it, as if always thirsty but unwilling to drink. Lately, he's taken to battering it around, sloshing the water out and sniffing and pawing at whatever spills, which is a lot. I'm going to try one of the dual-tank models that serve and drain, and don't recycle. On the plus side, the tank is big and the pump is reasonably quiet. Other downsides: the corded pump dangles from the lid assembly and makes refills really awkward.

reviews.title: PLEASE READ
reviews.body: Great for encouraging drinking, but requires A LOT of cleaningI purchased this fountain specifically because it’s stainless steel and because of the flower-shaped spout. My cat is picky about drinking water, and he’s much more interested when there are multiple streams/areas where the water comes out rather than just one single stream. This fountain has definitely encouraged him to drink more, which is a huge positive!I also prefer the stainless steel over plastic, so that was another big reason I chose this one.However, the cleaning is honestly a major pain. I’m not someone who doesn’t want to clean their pet’s things, I completely understand that water fountains require maintenance. But with this particular fountain, the amount of buildup that happens in such a short amount of time is excessive.Within 2 days, I can open it up and already find debris, food particles, and buildup in the bowl and components. If you let it go 3–4 days, it gets noticeably worse. By the time you get to around a week, it’s honestly pretty disgusting. The filter also becomes dark/dirty within about 4–5 days, which makes me question how effective it is when the recommended filter replacement is much less frequent.I’ve tried plastic fountains before, and although my cat didn’t like them as much, they didn’t seem to get this dirty this quickly.So my honest recommendation is: if you’re willing to thoroughly clean this fountain every 2 days (3 days max), it does a great job of encouraging a picky cat to drink. The flower design and multiple streams are definitely a hit with my cat, and the stainless steel is a plus.But if you’re expecting to clean your fountain every several days or once a week like many people typically do, I would not recommend this one. The rapid buildup and filter discoloration are the biggest drawbacks by far.This is probably the most honest review I’ve written because, despite my cat actually loving it, the maintenance is a serious downside. Yes it works but you have to be prepared to clean it constantly.

reviews.title: My dog Duke seems to like drinking from his new water dish.
reviews.body: The USB electrical cord is not easy to make unsightly if you don't have a place right near to plug it in. I had to use an extension cord and hang a hook on the wall to take up excess cord. You'll need easy access for washing & refilling.  My pup actually took to it rather quickly. More out of curiosity than thirst. Duke is usually quite reserved around 'new' things. He's been drinking from it regularly now. I think it will keep the water fresh longer than just a bowl of water that I changed every day. I'll have check for bacteria growing on the surface of the container when I go to clean it. I like the idea of the stainless material construction.

reviews.title: Let’s try something new !!!
reviews.body: Just received it the other day. Very easy set up. Only one cat has gone to it. The other one is staying away from it will watch for a couple more days.  If they were drinking from it a lot, I would give this five stars cause it’s a beautiful unit.Have removed all their bowls in the house to ensure they go to this unit. I’m a little nervous if one doesn’t drink from it at all it seems to be quiet enough, but the one cat is very sensitive to noise in different things.One cat is seven years old and one is eight years old so they’re just used to bowls. They haven’t ran to this like other videos show of other cats running to it.Will come back and review again with an update.

reviews.title: Steel fountain
reviews.body: I bought this based on other reviews stating how quiet it is. It is not quiet. The pump is quiet, yes, but it has a constant sound of dribbling water even after removing the flower shaper dropper. Even after making sure it is full, it still has the dribbling noise. I wanted to replace the plastic fountain I’ve been using, which is super quiet until the water level gets low, but this steel one is so much noisier. I returned it.

reviews.title: I like it, my cat does not
reviews.body: It was easy to put together. It runs quietly… I like it… My cat does not go near it. It’s been over a week… I have even brought my cat to the water but I can’t make him drink…I think I might need a different type attachment like a single spout running down to mimic a faucet…I will give it a few more days.

reviews.title: Meh water fountain, good budget option
reviews.body: just like every other single pump fountain, this fountain will accumulate grime and need to be replaced. not just on the filters but on the inside of the pump as well. good design though and when it's clean it is great, but even with cleaning it every other day the buildup of gunk is just not ideal. cats do drink from it and it's a solid choice if you don't have hard water.

reviews.title: Stainless Steel Cat Water Fountain - Venting
reviews.body: This stainless steel cat water fountain works fine. The venting on the top to allow water to go back in to cycle could use some work. I thought the stainless steel may keep cleaner than the plastic cat water fountains that we've bought in the past but I don't feel like it's any different. It works fine but I think my only complaint is the holes on the top so it is harder to fill from the top.

reviews.title: Good but broke 6 mos later
reviews.body: Great fountain but randomly died 6 months later, the pump stopped working even though it was just cleaned as usual. The large flower while cute, doesn't give cats much space to drink. Especially if they have whisker sensitivity.

reviews.title: Very disappointed at this product.  My kitten disassembled it within minutes.
reviews.body: This is the third Veken cat water fountain I have bought.  It probably is the last Veken water fountain that I will buy.  My kitten had no trouble disassembling this water fountain within minutes simply by pulling on the power cord.  A cheaper Veken water fountain, PFS3V243, has the power cord running through the chassis from top to bottom.  So, Veken knows about kittens disassembling water fountains by pulling on the power cord that comes out of the water fountain at the top.  Yet, this most expensive water fountain goes back to the very earliest (discontinued) design.

reviews.title: Quiet and easy to clean.
reviews.body: The fountain whisper quiet and very easy to clean. Which is great, because, unfortunately, you have to clean it way more often than any other fountain I've owned. It doesn't filter super great.

reviews.title: Water doesn’t stay in reservoir
reviews.body: It is fine but the one we had before with the offset fountain on the side was better for us. We are using this for our cat and shepherd. The shepherd tends to lap the water out of the top onto the floor whereas with the offset fountain she was able to keep it in the reservoir. I like having the led light and it’s easy to tell how much water is left. This one requires replacing the filter every two weeks where the last one was monthly - so definitely an added cost.

reviews.title: Works, but not for certain cats I guess
reviews.body: My cats head gets water spilled on it when he tries to drink from it, have to return it. Works like it should but design us to small for a medium sized cat

reviews.title: Overall great for price, but loud water trickle
reviews.body: I bought the original stainless steel model when it came out and decided to go for the upgrade. I’m very pleased with the silicone spout addition and like the ease of attaching the pump directly to the spout, but I feel that this model is much noisier than my other one. The pump is quiet, but there are noticeable water trickle noises that bug me, but I’ve decided aren’t worth returning (because who’s to say the next one I buy would be any better). Love the company and like the idea of the product but I think there could be additional improvement. Still better and more affordable than most others on the market.

reviews.title: I need the pump for the water fountain for my cat
reviews.body: I like the stainless steel but when I had all of it put together the water wouldn't come up to the top?? no water is is being dispensed !!. There was a card to say, "If the problem persists after trying the steps above,  please contact us for a free replacement."I did that on E-mail and hope I will get it this week!

reviews.title: It’s good, but rusts
reviews.body: The fountain works, is quiet, and my cat came around to drinking from in within a few days. I noticed a handful of people had issues with the pump dying and while I haven’t experienced that, the exterior of the fountain is rusting and it’s been about 5 months since I purchased. It’s relatively simple to clean, but the rusting is big concern for me, making this not as long-lasting of a purchase.

reviews.title: Quiet and attractive but poor cord design
reviews.body: The pump is quiet and the stainless is attractive. One HUGE design flaw: the cord to the pump comes out of the top of the fountain, which is not demonstrated in the photos. Clearly, this was not designed by someone familiar with cats and their mischievous behavior

reviews.title: Good but not great
reviews.body: Love the convenience of this fountain and love that it has a filter in ir. What i do not love is how slimy it gets in a few days and how long the filter lasts.After anywhere from 3 to 5 days, I havebto give this fountain and all its pieces a good wash. I really love how way it is to clean and to take apart. The stainless steel makes it dishwasher safe too which is amazing! But the main thing is my cats seem to love it and the little window on the front that shows when their water is getting low is so helpful. Again. The only issue i have is the short life expectancy on the filters and the slimy feeling after a few days.

reviews.title: Messy.
reviews.body: It's messy.  Water splashes out and stands on the small silicone mat.I took it apart to clean thoroughly after a couple of weeks.  The water was dirtier than I thought it should be with 2 filters and filtered water from the fridge.BUT the dogs are drinking more frequently and that was my main goal... that and one was always coughing after gulping too quickly.

reviews.title: Too noisy
reviews.body: Was looking to "upgrade" from an older plastic Veken model. The motor on this one is whisper quiet as advertised, but! The trickle of water from the top tray into the filter tray is maddening, and happens no matter what I do or what the fill level is.Back to the old one, until I want to pay $80 for one that's *actually* better.

reviews.title: Develops algae easily
reviews.body: I am doubting whether or not this is truly stainless steel. Despite the fountain always being on, so the water is never stagnant, it keeps growing algae. It has the filter in it and everything. In the future, I will buy these kind of items elsewhere.

reviews.title: Not for smart cats
reviews.body: I really liked this product and it worked well for its purpose for a short time. I love that it is Stainless Steel, has a filter, but unfortunately, my 8mo kitten is too smart and figured out how to take it apart. She isn’t really afraid of water much and plays in it as well as drinks from it. There’s no way to clamp or snap on the lids so that it can’t be opened. The tops just rest on top of each other, so my cat figured out that she can get her claw underneath the slits in the lids and pull them off, getting water everywhere, soaking everything around it…so I wish the design of it had a way to prevent that from happening. I also missed the return window, so can’t return it now; so bc she soaked everything, I had to stop using it, which sucks. Also, the very thin/flimsy mat that came with it, didn’t last more than a few hrs.

reviews.title: Some thoughts
reviews.body: Got the green. This color version definitely doesn't hold a gallon. Also, had to remove the fountain spout, as my cats' heads couldn't comfortably drink from it with that in the way. Despite that, they do drink from it now. And it is relatively quiet. However, if you require complete silence, this might not be a good fit in your bedroom, as there is an audible rhythm sound. I had to unplug it in the before falling asleep.

reviews.title: Great if you don’t mind the cord
reviews.body: It was a great item but I didn’t like the cord. It irritated my car who wouldn’t approach. Returned for a cordless option.

reviews.title: Loud water noise
reviews.body: It’s nice works well, but it’s not the quietest fountain I’ve had…definitely sounds like a water fountain.

reviews.title: Great but motor stopped after a year.
reviews.body: My cats & I really loved this stainless steel over the plastic fountain I had. Unfortunately it almost made it a year but the motor has stopped working..

reviews.title: Great product, stupid pets
reviews.body: Only 3 stars because although I like it a lot, neither my cat nor dog will use it.  It’s very quiet, works with a nice flow, easy to fill. I’m glad i got this cheaper model as a test, but it’s not a cheap product.  So I would highly recommend it if you know your pets are good with this type of watering.

reviews.title: Pump failed quickly
reviews.body: Purchased June 26th, and the pump stopped working by September 8th. Not thrilled about that but other than that its easy to clean

reviews.title: Loud
reviews.body: Very loud

reviews.title: Love this for my cats
reviews.body: I’m really happy with this cat water fountain! It’s quiet, easy to set up, and my cat started using it right away. The running water seems to encourage my cat to drink more throughout the day, which I really like.It’s also easy to clean and refill, and the design looks nice without taking up too much space. The water stays fresh and clean with regular maintenance. Overall, it’s a great little fountain and definitely a worthwhile purchase for any cat owner. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Cat’s favorite water station
reviews.body: My cat and I really like it. It is quiet and easy to use. I bought a very similar one from another company, and it broke on the third day. This one has been running for two months with no issues. Just remember that it needs to change filters every two weeks for the cat to stay healthy.

reviews.title: Sister's cat loves this!
reviews.body: This fountain was easy to put together and is very quiet when the fountain is on. With the light on the water level is clearly visible. My 2 Persians wouldn’t drink from it when it was on. I saw only 1 drink from it when I turned the fountain off, hoping they’d drink from it. After 5 days I emptied it, dried and took to my sister’s cat. Reassembled it and placed it for her cat. He loves it! She’s amazed how much he drank in less than a week. I think he loves the fresh water as well as it moves to lure him.

reviews.title: Just buy it!
reviews.body: This is a great gadget. I was on the "I'm not getting a water fountain for my cats" train for so long. Then summer hit and with it a bad heat wave plus the air conditioning system failing at our house. I was worried the cats weren't drinking enough water. Queue panic ordering of said water fountain. So glad I did. It was easy to set up, comes with filters, and it is very quiet. The stainless-steel version is easy to keep clean. I love that it has a window and and LED light that shows the water level. The cats are definitely drinking more water with this versus bowls.

reviews.title: Best customer service I've had in a while!
reviews.body: I've had this for 3 months and the pump stopped working. It was past the return date, so I wrote the company an email askimg for a replacement. I was expecting to get ghosted or some robot nonsense that I need to pay more than it's worth to ship it back to China etc.Instead, I got a very fast, professional response! They had a couple of trouble shooting steps for me before they sent me a new one. And guess what? It worked! I just had a bit of debris causing the impeller to stop. It works great now!!We need more customer service like these guys! Very friendly,  quick to respond, genuinely want to help.My pets LOVE this fountain BTW. My snooty dog refuses to drink from a plastic bowl, and she loves the water movement.  I dont blame her. I hate plastic too! 😆

reviews.title: Great Cat Fountain with Excellent Water Quality
reviews.body: I've been using this cat water fountain for several weeks and it has exceeded my expectations. My cat started drinking noticeably more water within the first few days, which was exactly what I was hoping for. The continuous flow seems to encourage hydration, and it's nice knowing my pet always  has access to fresh, filtered water. One of my biggest advantages is the stainless steel design. It feels much more hygienic than plastic fountains, is easy to clean, and doesn't retain odors or stains. The fountain looks modern and blends in nicely with my home, while the water reservoir holds enough water that I don't have to refill it constantly. The pump runs quietly for the most part and I can barely hear it when the water level is full. Assembly was simple, replacing the filters is straightforward. I also appreciate that replacement filters are readily available, making long-term maintenance easy. Great choice!

reviews.title: Stainless steel_great pet fountain
reviews.body: Love it.  Looks very durable, much prefer it to the plastic ones. The pets have taken to it as well. I also like the sound of the bubbling water in the background.  Finally, it has a large capacity so does not need refilling every day.

reviews.title: i’m really glad I bought this… But do your research
reviews.body: I live in a house that’s 167 years old and was turned into six apartments in the 1960s and the plumbing is very outdated as well as the water tank and by having the water tested I found out that there was a lot of little metal particles, basically sludge that was sitting at the bottom of the heating tank in the basement and I was concerned about drinking the water, then my fish tank having these particles in it as well as my cats drinking the regular Britta filtered water from the tap and that metal getting into their system so I looked into what was best and this was rated as one of the best water fountains  It wasn’t the first one I bought the first one I bought actually created a lot of biofilm after just a few days I was noticing green spots in the water and it was making my cat sick and I had to constantly change it every two days and since I bought this one, the filtration system seems to be much more sophisticated, you still have to do your water changes and you have to scrub everything out because it will get slimy just from natural bacteria from your cats using the fountain, but I find that they both love it, and it keeps the water flowing and cool and as long as you don’t have a problem, having to wipe it down with warm or hot water, no soap, do that every few days and I use springwater now anyways, but I thought we could it hurt to have this device and have my cats have access to the best possible drinking water that they could have and it’s not incredibly expensive.  It’s a little bit of a pain to change the filter and the cost of the filters aren’t in expensive but it’s worth it in the end and I’m telling you this brand in particular it’s much easier to clean this fountain than the one I had prior to this that look like it had a more simple design. It was much harder to clean, and this one in particular is easy to clean as long as you have an empty sink and hot water. That’s all you really need. You can use your fingers to get all the little bit of slime that you might feel and then change the water and change the filter depending on how many cats you have and what the directions tell you. I think I got my own sale for $35 and it was the best investment ever I would never go back to using a water bowl for a dog or a cat. Think of how much trouble we go to to make sure that our drinking water is is clean as it can be? Don’t our pets deserve that as well if we can manage it financially.? I live on a fixed income that is literally living under the poverty line and I can manage it and I wouldn’t go back for anything at this point.

reviews.title: Beautiful piece and stays clean!
reviews.body: This is quite possibly one of my favorite purchases for my new kitten. I've used it for 4 months now and it's been amazing. I had male cats growing up and remembered how important hydration was for them and them trying to drink out of faucets, so this was the most important purchase for my little guy. I was cautioned by a lot of friends not to get a fountain, they'd gotten one and said that they became dirty and slimy quite fast. Not this one.First, this fountain is completely dishwasher safe (except for the plastic pump of course). Disassemble it once a week and throw it in the dishwasher. While that's in the dishwasher, I take a small, pointed-end scrub brush and scrub the pump all over with unscented dishwasher soap and rinse. Sometimes if I have extra time, I'll plug the pump in and run it in a solution of vinegar+water, but this step is just me being extra. The filter I change out every 2 weeks as the instructions say. Once a month I like to scrub it out by hand. It has never gotten slimy, nasty, smelly, or anything of that sort. It stays completely clean and like new.Another key feature, its virtually noiseless. I have an open one-bedroom apartment, meaning my bedroom has no door. The whole apartment is connected. I dont hear this fountain at all, its very quite. My 7 month old kitten loves this fountain and I find myself refilling it often for him.It's very simple to use, I don't use the light often but it does add a little something to it. In general it's just a really good looking piece. Personally, I don't like the look of a lot of plastic items, and I don't like how they absorb smells/bacteria over time, so this stainless steel fountain checks a lot of boxes for me. The pump is still going strong so far.Replacement filters can be bought from the seller. There are some off-brand sellers that sell for cheaper, but my cats health isn't worth the gamble. I buy the filters in bulk and it works out nicely.All in all I love this purchase and I definitely recommend! Kitten stamp of approval!

reviews.title: BUY THIS NOW!!!
reviews.body: PLEASE READ:I have never wrote a review in my life, but when I tell you that this was worth every penny spent I mean it! I’ve had plastic water fountains in the past year and finally started reading on how bad they were. I started doing my research for a nice stainless steel water fountain for my babies. I read great things about this one but was worried about being let down, but I was so wrong, let’s get into it:1. Food grade! Safe for the babies!2.super quiet, it’s so crazy because you don’t hear it at all unless you’re down on the floor next to it.3.easy to put together!4. Comes with all your supplies and needs! It came with the block for the charger, extra sponges and filters, water mat and cleaning tools!!!4. Has a blue light so you can see how much is in there, best part is that there’s 2 buttons on the cord which has one to stop the water if you need to and the other one is to turn off the light if you don’t want it on.5.I’m so impressed with how much water this one holds. I’ve had other water fountains in the past that only held about 2 large cups of water. This one almost holds 5 large cups of water which is a lot because I have 4 cats so this will go a long way! Also if you turn off the pump, the water still stays at the top of the bowl for them if the power was to go out.6.it has a long cord so if you have an outlet far away it should reach!I’ve only had this up for an hour now and my cats keep coming back to it, I haven’t seen them drink this much water in a long time.The product is so sleek and modern and fits in perfectly with our other appliances. All I have to say is I’m super impressed and happy, my cats are super happy and they’re excited to drink water now!If you’re debating buying this product after searching like I did, I hope that you read this and take the chance on buying this fountain! :)
